en: A black and white postcard featuring two distinctively styled mansions with ornate architectural details and domes, surrounded by a low fence and lush garden. The foreground has a classical column and a planter with plants. The buildings appear to have Moorish or eclectic influences, with arched windows and decorative facades. Text at the bottom of the image identifies the location.
